audit.summary: Critical blockers found: logo is text-only and cannot be used for HTML5 ad hero generation; product portfolio lacks distinct SKUs for Bubble Tea campaign. While lifestyle scenes show physical products, primary_product_name values are either generic (collections) or misaligned with campaign focus on Bubble Tea kits and fruit pearls. Reference page scrape shows Bubble Tea-specific SKUs (AquaExotica, AquaFrutti, AquaRosa, AquaSummer, Monin syrups, fruit pearl variants) not represented in asset descriptions.
